say:5:1211401013:2.text: Sinbad's voice suddenly comes through the communicator.
say:5:1211401013:2.source_cn: 辛巴达的声音忽然从通讯器中传来……

say:9:1211401003:0.text: Hey, hey, hey—testing, testing, can you hear me? Is everyone alright?
say:9:1211401003:0.source_cn: 喂喂喂——测试测试，能听到我说话吗？你们几个没出意外吧？

choice_prompt:10:1211401003.text: Hey, hey, hey—testing, testing, can you hear me? Is everyone alright?
choice_prompt:10:1211401003.source_cn: 喂喂喂——测试测试，能听到我说话吗？你们几个没出意外吧？

say:11:1211401004:0.text: Great, everything's going well on my end too.
say:11:1211401004:0.source_cn: 那就好，我这边也很顺利。
say:11:1211401004:0.male: Great, everything's going well on my end too.
say:11:1211401004:0.female: Great, everything's going well on my end too.

say:16:1211401006:0.text: Stay vigilant, Sinbad. The Immortal has spotted you.
say:16:1211401006:0.source_cn: 辛巴达，提高警惕，不死号已经发现你了。

say:21:1211401007:0.text: No need to remind me! It's all part of the plan.
say:21:1211401007:0.source_cn: 用不着你提醒，这是我的战术。

say:22:1211401008:0.text: Board the Immortal now while you can. I'll keep them distracted.
say:22:1211401008:0.source_cn: 你们快趁现在登上不死号，我会尽力吸引他们的注意。

say:27:1211401009:0.text: Hodgkin won't be fooled that easily. If you start getting all showy, Sinbad, he'll definitely be suspicious.
say:27:1211401009:0.source_cn: 霍德希金没那么容易上当，你大摇大摆地出现，他一定会怀疑。

say:28:1211401010:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, time's running short. Let's board the ship and move fast.
say:28:1211401010:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, time's running short. Let's board the ship and move fast.
say:28:1211401010:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, time's running short. Let's board the ship and move fast.

say:33:1211401011:0.text: C'mon, Sonja! I'm doing my best to hold them off. Can't you say something nice about me for once?
say:33:1211401011:0.source_cn: 我在努力牵制他们，你怎么一句好话都不会说？
say:33:1211401011:0.male: C'mon, Sonja! I'm doing my best to hold them off. Can't you say something nice about me for once?
say:33:1211401011:0.female: C'mon, Sonja! I'm doing my best to hold them off. Can't you say something nice about me for once?

say:34:1211401012:0.text: Alright, alright... I don't wanna ruin the mood before a fight. Be careful, you guys. I'll find a way to join you soon.
say:34:1211401012:0.source_cn: 算了算了……打架前我可不想扫兴。你们小心点，我也会想办...

say:37:1211401005:0.text: Hey! Do I really seem that unreliable to you?
say:37:1211401005:0.source_cn: 喂！在你眼里我有这么不靠谱吗？
say:37:1211401005:0.male: Hey! Do I really seem that unreliable to you?
say:37:1211401005:0.female: Hey! Do I really seem that unreliable to you?

choice:10:1:2.text: I should be asking you that.
choice:10:1:2.male: I should be asking you that.
choice:10:1:2.female: I should be asking you that.

say:0:1211401201:0.text: Let's climb the ladder and board the ship.

say:3:1211403002:1.text: Sinbad! How did you get here?

say:4:1211403003:0.text: I can't use magic, so I swam over!
say:4:1211403003:0.source_cn: 我又不会魔法，当然是游过来的！

say:5:1211403004:0.text: You fool! That was such a risky move.

say:7:1211403005:0.text: Would you rather I watched from afar while you fought? There's no way I'd do that.
say:7:1211403005:0.source_cn: 难道要我远远看着你们拼命？我可做不到。

say:8:1211403006:1.text: You should be providing backup, not—
say:8:1211403006:1.source_cn: 你应该为我们提供后援！而不是——

say:9:1211403007:1.text: Relax, Sonja. I've steered the Chainkeeper to a safe distance, and Hugin's helping at the helm.
say:9:1211403007:1.source_cn: 行了行了。我把枷锁号驶到了相对安全的距离，呼金老兄在帮...

say:10:1211403008:1.text: If you have time to nag me, use that time instead to pray he doesn't sink the ship.
say:10:1211403008:1.source_cn: 你要是有空啰嗦，还不如祈祷他别把船开沉了呢。

say:11:1211403009:1.text: ... I just hope we'll all get out safe.

say:12:1211403010:1.text: There's no need to be so pessimistic! We're so close to the end now, we've got this.
say:12:1211403010:1.source_cn: 都到这一步了，哪有什么退路？没看出来你也有天真的一面啊。

say:13:1211403011:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why don't you comfort her? She seems really tense for some reason.
say:13:1211403011:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why don't you comfort her? She seems really tense for some reason.
say:13:1211403011:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why don't you comfort her? She seems really tense for some reason.

choice_prompt:14:1211403011.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why don't you comfort her? She seems really tense for some reason.
choice_prompt:14:1211403011.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why don't you comfort her? She seems really tense for some reason.

say:15:1211403012:1.text: Thank you for the compliment, but...
say:15:1211403012:1.male: Thank you for the compliment, but...
say:15:1211403012:1.female: Thank you for the compliment, but...

say:16:1211403015:1.text: Oh... Stop overthinking it, alright? We'll definitely take down Hodgkin!
say:16:1211403015:1.source_cn: 哎哟……别想太多了行不行？我们一定打能败霍德希金！

say:17:1211403016:1.text: The deck is broken. Instead of dawdling here, let's find another way across.
say:17:1211403016:1.source_cn: 甲板已经断了，与其在这里磨磨蹭蹭，还是快找找有没有其他...

say:19:1211403013:1.text: She... probably doesn't need my concern.
say:19:1211403013:1.source_cn: 她大概……不需要我的关心。
say:19:1211403013:1.male: She... probably doesn't need my concern.
say:19:1211403013:1.female: She... probably doesn't need my concern.

say:20:1211403014:1.text: At this point, I don't want anyone else to die in vain. There have been enough sacrifices.
say:20:1211403014:1.source_cn: 事到如今，我不希望大家白白送死。牺牲的人已经够多了。
say:20:1211403014:1.male: At this point, I don't want anyone else to die in vain. There have been enough sacrifices.
say:20:1211403014:1.female: At this point, I don't want anyone else to die in vain. There have been enough sacrifices.

choice:14:2:3.text: Sonja cares about all of us.
choice:14:2:3.male: Sonja cares about all of us.
choice:14:2:3.female: Sonja cares about all of us.

say:0:1211403101:0.text: This way is blocked, let's go around from above.
say:0:1211403101:0.source_cn: 这里被堵住了，从上面绕过去看看。

say:0:1211404001:0.source_cn: 入侵者在这里！快去叫增援！

say:1:1211404002:0.text: Sorry, can't let ya do that.
say:1:1211404002:0.source_cn: 不好意思，你恐怕没那个机会了。

say:0:1211404101:0.text: There should be an exit to the deck leading to Hodgkin.
say:0:1211404101:0.source_cn: 进船舱，应该有出口通往霍德希金那边的甲板。

say:1:1211405001:1.text: To catch Hodgkin, we'll have to bypass this broken deck and head down.
say:1:1211405001:1.source_cn: 想要追击霍德希金，得绕开断裂的甲板，只能往下走了。

say:2:1211405002:1.text: We should be able to find another ladder.
say:2:1211405002:1.source_cn: 这下边应该能找到另外一处上行的梯子。

say:3:1211405003:1.text: The Immortal is most likely riddled with traps. Be careful, everyone.
say:3:1211405003:1.source_cn: 不死号上肯定处处藏有机关，大家一定要小心点。

say:0:1211405101:0.source_cn: 找到了！通往霍德希金那边甲板的出口！

say:3:1211406001:1.text: These... are flames ignited by the power of gravecalling magic.
say:3:1211406001:1.source_cn: 这是……用死灵法术点燃的火焰。

say:4:1211406002:1.text: They hunger for living souls, feeding on their screams as they turn to ash. Many of my crew have fallen to these green flames...
say:4:1211406002:1.source_cn: 这些火焰喜爱鲜活的生命，更喜欢生命惨叫着化为焦炭。有许...

say:5:1211406003:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think you can extinguish them?
say:5:1211406003:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think you can extinguish them?
say:5:1211406003:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think you can extinguish them?

say:10:1211406007:0.text: I understand. Let's forget about this path for now and look elsewhere.
say:10:1211406007:0.source_cn: 好吧，看来这条路暂时走不通了，我们再看看其他地方。

say:0:1211406101:0.text: There must be something in the cabin that can dispel the gravecalling fire.
say:0:1211406101:0.source_cn: 船舱里一定有可以驱散亡灵火焰的东西，找一找。

say:0:1211408001:0.text: We can't contact Hugin down here. Let's hope he can keep the Chainkeeper safe.
say:0:1211408001:0.source_cn: 这下边没法与呼金取得联系，但愿他能好好保护枷锁号。

say:1:1211409002:0.text: I admit, Hodgkin really doesn't strike me as the scholarly type.
say:1:1211409002:0.source_cn: 霍德希金可不像是会看书的。

say:1:1211411001:1.text: But there's nothing in the drawers except dust.
say:1:1211411001:1.source_cn: 除了灰尘，抽屉里什么都没有。

say:2:1211411002:1.text: There's something odd about this room... I can't quite put my finger on it.
say:2:1211411002:1.source_cn: 但我总感觉这间屋子有些诡异……说不上来是哪里不对劲。

say:3:1211411003:1.text: Should we search more thoroughly? The sailor instinct in me is yelling that we'll find something significant.
say:3:1211411003:1.source_cn: 要不再仔细找找？说不定有什么大发现呢。

say:0:1211412001:1.text: The candles in the room flicker eerily, as if your breath has awakened them from their slumber. Only the candle in front of you stays unlit.
say:0:1211412001:1.source_cn: 除了眼前这支烛台，屋内的蜡烛都被点燃了。

say:0:1211413001:0.text: A soulless, fractured bone. If you look closely, you'll see that it's not a real fish bone but a carving with <style="highlight">"Bantus"</style> engraved on the back. It appears to have been gouged by something sharp.
say:0:1211413001:0.source_cn: 一截没有灵魂的断骨。如果细看，你会发现这不是真正的鱼骨...

say:1:1211414001:0.text: Empty bottles clutter the crates. Nobody can recall where the wine went. They were left behind and forgotten yesterday, along with the surprise of opening them.
say:1:1211414001:0.source_cn: 空空的酒瓶凌乱地堆在箱子里，无人记得瓶中的琼浆去向何方...

say:0:1211415001:0.source_cn: 快来！我找到一个有意思的东西！

say:3:1211417001:1.source_cn: 辛巴达，你手上拿着什么？

say:4:1211417002:1.source_cn: 一张什么都没写的白纸。

say:7:1211417004:1.text: Not at all. But look at what's in my other hand. I also found this!
say:7:1211417004:1.source_cn: 当然没用。但是除此之外，我还找到了这个！

say:9:1211417005:1.text: This is a Dragonflame Spire. It's highly sought after during wars, and it's a super rare item.
say:9:1211417005:1.source_cn: 这叫龙息柱，在战争时期可是旅人们梦寐以求的物品，现在已...

say:10:1211417006:1.text: The flames ignite if you blow lightly on the ring. It's very handy for people who can't use magic.
say:10:1211417006:1.source_cn: 只要在圈口轻轻吹气，随时能点燃火焰。对于不会魔法的旅行...

say:11:1211417007:1.text: Why would someone use that when matches exist? It's pretty big compared to matches.
say:11:1211417007:1.source_cn: 如今火柴很普遍了，这东西也没什么用处嘛。

say:13:1211417009:0.text: There's supposedly dragon grease at the base. Dragon flames can burn anywhere, even on water.
say:13:1211417009:0.source_cn: 据说这东西底部储存着龙的油脂。龙焰能在任何地方燃烧，甚...

say:17:1211417010:1.text: It can burn anywhere, you say...?

say:18:1211417011:1.text: Sonja, did you think of something?

say:19:1211417012:1.text: Something's felt off to me ever since we entered this study. Call it years of honing my instincts.
say:19:1211417012:1.source_cn: 其实进入这间书房后，我有种不协调的感觉。

say:20:1211417013:1.text: There are six candelabras arranged symmetrically, but the one by the window isn't lit.
say:20:1211417013:1.source_cn: 屋内共有六盏对称分布的烛台，唯独窗边的这一盏熄灭了。

say:21:1211417014:1.text: I tried to light it, but the wick is damp and it won't catch fire.
say:21:1211417014:1.source_cn: 我试着点燃它，却发现烛芯潮湿软塌，难以燃烧。

choice_prompt:22:1211417014.text: I tried to light it, but the wick is damp and it won't catch fire.
choice_prompt:22:1211417014.source_cn: 我试着点燃它，却发现烛芯潮湿软塌，难以燃烧。

say:23:1211417015:1.text: Exactly. Sinbad said this ship is full of traps and various mechanisms. This might unlock one of them.
say:23:1211417015:1.source_cn: 没错，辛巴达说过，不死号内藏有各式机关。这或许是突破口。
say:23:1211417015:1.male: Exactly. Sinbad said this ship is full of traps and various mechanisms. This might unlock one of them.
say:23:1211417015:1.female: Exactly. Sinbad said this ship is full of traps and various mechanisms. This might unlock one of them.

say:24:1211417017:1.text: B-but! Dragonflame Spires are extremely rare! And look how much dust is accumulated on this one, there's no telling how old it is! Who knows how many uses it has left...?
say:24:1211417017:1.source_cn: 龙息柱很稀有啊！这根都旧了，也不知道还能用几次……

say:25:1211417018:1.text: My dearest, most wonderful, absolutely favorite fellow travelers, couldn't we... maybe think of another way?

choice_prompt:26:1211417018.text: My dearest, most wonderful, absolutely favorite fellow travelers, couldn't we... maybe think of another way?

say:27:1211417019:1.text: Hey, be careful with that! That's probably worth 100 times of what I make in a year!
say:27:1211417019:1.source_cn: 诶——拿稳了！这东西贵着呢！
say:27:1211417019:1.male: Hey, be careful with that! That's probably worth 100 times of what I make in a year!
say:27:1211417019:1.female: Hey, be careful with that! That's probably worth 100 times of what I make in a year!

say:30:1211417020:1.source_cn: 好了好了……我给你还不行吗！
say:30:1211417020:1.male: Fine, fine! Just take it, you cruel, cruel person!
say:30:1211417020:1.female: Fine, fine! Just take it, you cruel, cruel person!

say:31:1211417021:1.text: How did you turn from an angel to a devil so quickly?! Fine, I guess I have no choice...
say:31:1211417021:1.source_cn: 你这人……变脸也太快了吧！我给你就是……
say:31:1211417021:1.male: How did you turn from an angel to a devil so quickly?! Fine, I guess I have no choice...
say:31:1211417021:1.female: How did you turn from an angel to a devil so quickly?! Fine, I guess I have no choice...

choice:26:2:3.text: You'll regret it if you don't.
choice:26:2:3.male: You'll regret it if you don't.
choice:26:2:3.female: You'll regret it if you don't.

say:32:1211417016:1.text: You took the words right out of my mouth.
say:32:1211417016:1.male: You took the words right out of my mouth.
say:32:1211417016:1.female: You took the words right out of my mouth.

say:3:1211420001:0.text: Those Graveborns look like they're moving something.
say:3:1211420001:0.source_cn: 咦，那些亡灵好像在搬东西？

say:4:1211420002:0.text: Chippy smells sulfur... Maybe they're moving cannonballs? Or gunpowder?

say:5:1211420003:0.text: Whatever it is, I think we should wreak some havoc!
say:5:1211420003:0.source_cn: 不管是哪种，我们得给他们制造点破坏。

say:0:1211421001:0.text: Hey buddy! You look tired, why don't you rest for a bit?
say:0:1211421001:0.source_cn: 他们在搬运炸药，不能让他们得逞！

say:2:1211423001:0.text: I'll never tell you nothin'! You should just give up now!
say:2:1211423001:0.source_cn: 我什么都不会说！你们趁早放弃！

say:3:1211423002:0.text: Yeah, that was pretty much a given. A big oaf like you probably isn't ever invited to tactical meetings.
say:3:1211423002:0.source_cn: 我猜也是。\n看你这傻大个的模样，船员聚在一起讨论战术...

say:4:1211423003:1.text: That's bull! I'm the most trustworthy there is, I know everything! But I'm loyal, so I won't tell you anything!
say:4:1211423003:1.source_cn: 胡说！我知道！但我忠诚，我不说！

say:5:1211423004:1.text: *Sigh* Just admit you know nothing. I promise, I'm a good guy, I won't laugh at you.
say:5:1211423004:1.source_cn: 说不出来就承认嘛，我又不会笑你。

say:6:1211423005:1.text: There's always a few overlooked members on every ship. I get it, I've been there.
say:6:1211423005:1.source_cn: 一艘船上总有那么几个不被重视的边缘人物，没事，不丢人。

say:7:1211423006:1.text: N-no! I attend all the tactical meetings, they'd never leave me out... right?
say:7:1211423006:1.source_cn: 不……不！我知道！我参与了作战会议！

say:8:1211423007:1.text: Psh, who would believe that? You're just a grunt, delegated to moving explosives.
say:8:1211423007:1.source_cn: 哎哟，谁信呐。你不就是个搬炸药的苦力么？

say:9:1211423008:1.text: I'm not! The captain sent me to protect a mage here, my job is the most important of them all!
say:9:1211423008:1.source_cn: 我不是！船长派我在这里保护炼金术师！我的工作很重要！

say:10:1211423009:1.text: Aha, are we playing how we can lie the most? Here's my attempt: I'm Hodgkin's spy, planted in Rustport!
say:10:1211423009:1.source_cn: 这话我也能编，我还说我是霍德希金安插在锈锚港的间谍呢。

say:11:1211423010:1.text: Y-you... I'm not lying! The captain values that mage because he's the only one who can open certain doors on this ship! So that means I'm super important too, to be guarding him.
say:11:1211423010:1.source_cn: 我没有骗你！船长很重视那名炼金术师！因为有些门只有他才...

say:12:1211423011:1.text: Oho, that's quite useful. Thanks, octopus head.
say:12:1211423011:1.source_cn: 嗯哼，不错的情报。谢啦，章鱼头老哥。

say:13:1211423012:1.text: Now, it's time to go night-night.
say:13:1211423012:1.source_cn: 现在，你可以好好睡一觉了。

narration:16:1211423017:0.text: Sinbad swiftly knocks the opponent out.
narration:16:1211423017:0.source_cn: 辛巴达利落地打晕了对方……

say:19:1211423014:1.text: Sinbad, you've got a knack for this.

say:20:1211423015:1.text: You gotta be a smooth talker if you do what I do for a living!
say:20:1211423015:1.source_cn: 不值一提，基础中的基础。

say:21:1211423016:1.source_cn: 好了，我们去找找这傻瓜说的炼金术师吧。

say:0:1211424001:0.text: Ugh! Judging by this pungent smell, the mage must be nearby!
say:0:1211424001:0.source_cn: 唔……！好刺鼻的味道，炼金术师一定在附近！

say:0:1211425001:0.source_cn: 找到了！看样子锅里正热乎着呢。

say:3:1211427001:0.text: You look smarter than the other cods on here. Someone like you wouldn't be foolish enough to trust your crewmates, yeah?
say:3:1211427001:0.source_cn: 行了行了，我看你挺机灵的，应该不会傻到相信自己的笨蛋队友吧？

say:5:1211427002:0.text: They're already done for. And you know... those wily bastards sold you out before they kicked the bucket.
say:5:1211427002:0.source_cn: 他们已经被干掉了，被干掉之前还顺手把你卖了。

say:6:1211427003:1.text: If you don't want to meet the same fate, you'd better cooperate.
say:6:1211427003:1.source_cn: 你要是不想落个同样的下场，就乖乖听话。

say:7:1211427004:1.text: What do you want to know...?

say:8:1211427005:1.text: One of your little friends said that you can open those special doors.
say:8:1211427005:1.source_cn: 你的好队友说，你能打开那些特殊的门。

say:10:1211427007:0.text: But you all rushed me so fast, I accidentally dropped the key into the cauldron. It's melted by now.
say:10:1211427007:0.source_cn: 但是你们刚才突然闯过来攻击我，我一哆嗦，钥匙掉进坩埚里...

say:12:1211427008:0.text: There's no way you don't have a spare key. Hand it over!
say:12:1211427008:0.source_cn: 钥匙不可能只有一把，赶紧把备用钥匙交出来！

say:14:1211427009:1.text: Of course there is, but the spare key's with the captain. You'll have to get it from him, unfortunately.
say:14:1211427009:1.source_cn: 备用钥匙当然有，只不过，在船长手里。恐怕你们得去找他要了。

say:15:1211427010:0.text: Looks like you're asking for a beating—

say:16:1211427011:0.text: Calm down, Sinbad! Leave it to our magister!
say:16:1211427011:0.source_cn: 冷静，辛巴达！剩下的交给梅林吧！
say:16:1211427011:0.male: Calm down, Sinbad! Leave it to our magister!
say:16:1211427011:0.female: Calm down, Sinbad! Leave it to our magister!

say:17:1211427012:1.text: We can just forge the key, it'll be a piece of cake for our Magister Merlin.
say:17:1211427012:1.source_cn: 重铸钥匙而已，这对梅林来说易如反掌！
say:17:1211427012:1.male: We can just forge the key, it'll be a piece of cake for our Magister Merlin.
say:17:1211427012:1.female: We can just forge the key, it'll be a piece of cake for our Magister Merlin.

say:0:1211428001:0.text: This doesn't look like a key at all!

say:1:1211428002:0.text: I see, the "key" was actually a potion that can dispel gravecalling fire!
say:1:1211428002:0.source_cn: 满满不懂了吧，这是可以驱散亡灵火焰的药水！

say:0:1211428101:0.text: Get to the upper deck and find Hodgkin!

say:2:1211430001:1.text: Huh! Hodgkin, that sly bastard... He's just toying with us!
say:2:1211430001:1.source_cn: 霍德希金这混蛋……跟我们玩阴的。

say:3:1211430002:1.text: Stay calm. You'll make more careless mistakes if you're riled up.
say:3:1211430002:1.source_cn: 沉住气，越是急躁，越容易露出破绽。

say:4:1211430003:1.text: He's afraid of us. That's why he's pulling underhanded tricks like this.
say:4:1211430003:1.source_cn: 他对我们有所畏惧，否则也不会与我们在暗中周旋。

say:5:1211430004:1.text: His defeat was sealed from the moment he began fearing us.
say:5:1211430004:1.source_cn: 从他对我们心怀畏惧的那一刻起，他的失败已经注定了。

say:1:1211432001:0.text: We must figure out how to deal with the kraken that Hodgkin summoned.
say:1:1211432001:0.source_cn: 霍德希金召唤了那个海怪，我们要怎么应对？

say:3:1211432002:0.text: Wait, what? There's no way we can defeat it on our own! It could swipe us halfway across the sea with just one tentacle. W-We're not even big enough to be a snack!
say:3:1211432002:0.source_cn: 说什么呢？光靠我们肯定打不过那个怪物！它一根触手就能把...

say:4:1211432003:0.text: We need Hugin's cannon. Contact him!
say:4:1211432003:0.source_cn: 我们需要呼金的炮。联络他！

say:5:1211432004:0.text: Hugin... Hugin! Damn it, answer me!

say:17:1211432006:0.text: Hugin! Are you saying you have a plan? What is it?!
say:17:1211432006:0.source_cn: 有声音了！呼金！你说你有办法？是什么！

say:22:1211432007:0.text: I need to go back to Rustport and upgrade Merlindabest! I just thought of a way to amplify the signal!
say:22:1211432007:0.source_cn: 等我回到锈锚港，必须给小梅的组件升个级！我刚刚想出了一...

say:27:1211432008:0.text: What the kraken are you saying? This isn't the time for discussing communicators. We have an actual kraken to deal with!
say:27:1211432008:0.source_cn: 谁和你说这个？现在不是聊通讯器的时候，你也看到那怪物了...

say:32:1211432009:0.text: I know! It's so huge, I couldn't miss it if I tried!
say:32:1211432009:0.source_cn: 它这么大，我想看不见都难！

say:33:1211432010:0.text: Don't worry, keep moving forward. There are <style="highlight">two cannons</style> ahead!
say:33:1211432010:0.source_cn: 先别着急，你们继续往前走，那里有<style=high...

say:34:1211432011:0.text: Call me when you get there! I'll steer the Chainkeeper to the other side. The tentacles are about to flip the ship!
say:34:1211432011:0.source_cn: 你们靠近了再联系我！我先把枷锁号开到另一侧，这怪物的触...

say:0:1211433001:0.text: Be careful! Let's go find the cannons and fight back!
say:0:1211433001:0.source_cn: 小心触手！快去找大炮对付它！

say:0:1211434015:2.text: Hugin's voice suddenly comes through the communicator.
say:0:1211434015:2.source_cn: 呼金的声音突然从通讯器中传来……

say:4:1211434001:0.text: You guys there yet? Can you describe what the cannon looks like?
say:4:1211434001:0.source_cn: 你们到了？谁能给我详细描述一下那大炮的样子？

say:9:1211434002:0.text: Cannons are cannons! Well... don't they all look alike? It's got an iron plate on top and a pointed rear—
say:9:1211434002:0.source_cn: 呃……炮不都长得差不多吗？它的上面有一块铁板，屁股是尖的——

say:14:1211434003:0.source_cn: 屁股是尖的？错不了！那是我造的炮！

say:15:1211434004:0.text: They stole my blueprints and forged it themselves!
say:15:1211434004:0.source_cn: 准确来说，是他们偷走了我的设计图以后自己造的炮！

say:16:1211434005:0.text: I can't promise much, but it should bust up a few tentacles, assuming they didn't cut corners!
say:16:1211434005:0.source_cn: 别的我不敢保证，但它起码能轰断那怪物几根触手！前提是他...

say:21:1211434006:0.text: How am I even supposed to tell if they did?

say:26:1211434007:0.text: Don't sweat the details. My designs are solid!
say:26:1211434007:0.source_cn: 你不需要多想，我相信我的设计图！

say:27:1211434008:0.text: Sinbad, come back to the Chainkeeper. We'll bombard it from the outside while the others fire from the Immortal. We'll trap the monster in a crossfire!
say:27:1211434008:0.source_cn: 辛巴达，你得回到枷锁号来，我们从外围开炮，让他们从不死...

say:32:1211434009:0.text: Buddy... You're kidding, right? How am I supposed to get over there? Jumping into the sea now is like jumping straight into the monster's belly!
say:32:1211434009:0.source_cn: 伙计……你在开玩笑？我现在跳海等于直接跳进那怪物的胃里！

say:37:1211434010:0.text: I'll get closer and shoot a grappling hook so that you can swing over!
say:37:1211434010:0.source_cn: 我再靠近一点，射个钩锁过去，你顺着绳子荡过来！

say:42:1211434011:0.text: You... Oh! You're always full of the most harebrained schemes! ...Whatever, fine! Worst comes to worst, I'll just become a snack for the fish!
say:42:1211434011:0.source_cn: 净出馊主意！\n……行吧！大不了喂鱼呗！

say:43:1211434012:1.text: But the cannons aren't loaded, and we haven't seen any cannonballs. What are we supposed to shoot?
say:43:1211434012:1.source_cn: 可是这炮没上膛，我们也没看到炮弹，两门空炮能炸出什么火花？

say:48:1211434013:0.text: My cannons require a special ammo. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please search nearby. They must have hidden them somewhere!
say:48:1211434013:0.source_cn: 我的炮需要填充特殊弹药，<style=stress><...
say:48:1211434013:0.male: My cannons require a special ammo. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please search nearby. They must have hidden them somewhere!
say:48:1211434013:0.female: My cannons require a special ammo. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please search nearby. They must have hidden them somewhere!

say:49:1211434014:0.text: The kraken that was summoned seems extremely agitated and not fully under Hodgkin's control. We need to act fast!
say:49:1211434014:0.source_cn: 那怪物刚被召唤出来，似乎还很狂躁，不怎么听霍德希金的使...

say:0:1211434101:0.text: Could he be controlling that monster with the artifact?
say:0:1211434101:0.source_cn: 霍德希金竟然能操控这样的怪物……也是因为圣器吗？

say:0:1211434401:0.text: Magister, you can guide the tentacles to smash the obstacles!
say:0:1211434401:0.source_cn: 梅林，可以引导触手来打碎障碍物！
say:0:1211434401:0.male: Magister, you can guide the tentacles to smash the obstacles!
say:0:1211434401:0.female: Magister, you can guide the tentacles to smash the obstacles!

say:0:1211435001:0.text: This way will be faster. Let's blast through these obstacles!
say:0:1211435001:0.source_cn: 从这里走更近，直接炸开这些障碍物吧！

say:0:1211436301:0.text: We must deal with those pesky tentacles first!
say:0:1211436301:0.source_cn: 先解决那怪物难缠的触手！

say:0:1211437001:0.text: Watch out, the monster's main body has appeared!
say:0:1211437001:0.source_cn: 梅林小心，那怪物的本体出现了！
say:0:1211437001:0.male: Watch out, the monster's main body has appeared!
say:0:1211437001:0.female: Watch out, the monster's main body has appeared!

narration:0:1211437201:0.text: You quickly return to the Chainkeeper before the Immortal capsizes...
narration:0:1211437201:0.source_cn: 不死号翻船前，我们迅速回到了枷锁号……

say:2:1211438001:1.text: He tried to control the sea, only to be swallowed by it...
say:2:1211438001:1.source_cn: 妄图掌控海洋，却最终被海洋吞没……

say:3:1211438002:1.source_cn: 多么可笑的结局，倒是与他相配。

say:4:1211438003:0.text: There's no time to dwell on that!
say:4:1211438003:0.source_cn: 打住！我们可没空替他伤感！

say:6:1211438004:1.text: Sinbad, we gotta run! The Immortal's sinking and creating a whirlpool. We can't get caught in it!
say:6:1211438004:1.source_cn: 辛巴达，得赶紧远离这里！不死号沉没会形成虹吸的漩涡，我...

say:11:1211438006:0.text: We've won... so there's no way I'd let us die with that madman!
say:11:1211438006:0.source_cn: 好不容易才赢得了胜利……我不会让大家给那疯子陪葬！

say:13:1211438007:1.text: Hold on tight! Full sail... port side!

narration:15:1211438009:0.source_cn: 我们乘船回到了锈锚港……

say:1:1211440001:0.text: There is so much to do, but Lucca said he'll help with it all. I'll be very busy soon.
say:1:1211440001:0.source_cn: 需要处理的事情堆积如山，卢卡正在帮我应付着，再过一会儿...
say:1:1211440001:0.male: There is so much to do, but Lucca said he'll help with it all. I'll be very busy soon.
say:1:1211440001:0.female: There is so much to do, but Lucca said he'll help with it all. I'll be very busy soon.

say:2:1211440002:0.text: But before that, I would like to sincerely thank you.
say:2:1211440002:0.source_cn: 在那之前，无论如何我都要向你郑重道谢。
say:2:1211440002:0.male: But before that, I would like to sincerely thank you.
say:2:1211440002:0.female: But before that, I would like to sincerely thank you.

say:3:1211440003:0.text: You've lifted the fog over Rustport. Merlin—I finally understand the meaning of that title.
say:3:1211440003:0.source_cn: 你为锈锚港拨开了迷雾。梅林——我终于知道了这个称号的含义。
say:3:1211440003:0.male: You've lifted the fog over Rustport. Merlin—I finally understand the meaning of that title.
say:3:1211440003:0.female: You've lifted the fog over Rustport. Merlin—I finally understand the meaning of that title.

say:5:1211440005:0.text: The rest of the Dead Tide Fleet has fled, and the Water Wights have lost... that person.
say:5:1211440005:0.source_cn: 眼下死潮舰队的残党败走，水鬼帮也失去了……那个人。

choice_prompt:6:1211440005.text: The rest of the Dead Tide Fleet has fled, and the Water Wights have lost... that person.

say:7:1211440006:0.text: With the Water Wights leaderless and dispersed, chaos could ensue once more if they're left unchecked.
say:7:1211440006:0.source_cn: 水鬼帮如今没有了领袖，如散沙一盘，如果放任不管，他们恐...

say:8:1211440007:0.text: I'm inclined to take them in, if they're willing.
say:8:1211440007:0.source_cn: 我想接纳他们，但这也得看他们的意愿了。

say:9:1211440008:0.text: In any case, we, the Carmine Whispers, will safeguard this hard-won peace.
say:9:1211440008:0.source_cn: 总之，这份来之不易的风平浪静，血薇帮众会尽己所能地守护。

say:10:1211440009:0.text: Once again, my deepest respect to you.
say:10:1211440009:0.source_cn: 请允许我再次向你表达诚挚的敬意。
say:10:1211440009:0.male: Once again, my deepest respect to you.
say:10:1211440009:0.female: Once again, my deepest respect to you.

say:11:1211440010:0.text: You hold an esteemed title, but when I sing of your deeds to the world, I will tell them your true name.
say:11:1211440010:0.source_cn: 你有着尊贵的称号，但我向世人歌颂你的事迹时，会将你的真...
say:11:1211440010:0.male: You hold an esteemed title, but when I sing of your deeds to the world, I will tell them your true name.
say:11:1211440010:0.female: You hold an esteemed title, but when I sing of your deeds to the world, I will tell them your true name.

say:12:1211440011:0.text: From now on, your deeds will echo through Rustport's skies, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:12:1211440011:0.source_cn: 以后锈锚港的天空上，只会盘旋你响亮的名字——<styl...

say:13:1211440012:0.text: Now, please allow me to take care of one last personal matter—
say:13:1211440012:0.source_cn: 现在，请允许我处理最后一件私事——
say:13:1211440012:0.male: Now, please allow me to take care of one last personal matter—
say:13:1211440012:0.female: Now, please allow me to take care of one last personal matter—

say:15:1211440013:1.text: Nara, I will cherish your memory in this way...
say:15:1211440013:1.source_cn: 奈拉，我将以这样的方式……祭奠你。

say:17:1211440004:0.text: Is that so? Perhaps humility is also a part of greatness.
say:17:1211440004:0.source_cn: 是吗。也许谦卑也是伟大的一部分。
say:17:1211440004:0.male: Is that so? Perhaps humility is also a part of greatness.
say:17:1211440004:0.female: Is that so? Perhaps humility is also a part of greatness.

choice:4:1:2.text: I'd like to keep a low profile.
choice:4:1:2.male: I'd like to keep a low profile.
choice:4:1:2.female: I'd like to keep a low profile.

say:2:1211442001:1.text: Did you hear? People on the streets are calling us heroes!
say:2:1211442001:1.source_cn: 你来的路上听见没有？有人夸我们是英雄。
say:2:1211442001:1.male: Did you hear? People on the streets are calling us heroes!
say:2:1211442001:1.female: Did you hear? People on the streets are calling us heroes!

say:3:1211442002:1.text: I never thought a drifter like me could be a hero. This feels like a dream.
say:3:1211442002:1.source_cn: 没想到，我这样的无业游民也能和英雄两个字沾边，简直像做...
say:3:1211442002:1.male: I never thought a drifter like me could be a hero. This feels like a dream.
say:3:1211442002:1.female: I never thought a drifter like me could be a hero. This feels like a dream.

say:4:1211442003:1.text: So can we still be friends? Because I'm not into slackers, or larger-than-life heroes.
say:4:1211442003:1.source_cn: 那咱还能当朋友吗？因为我不爱跟吊儿郎当的混子相处，也不...

say:5:1211442004:1.text: Hugin, my friend, we have a special bond forged through battle. In your presence, I'm just Sinbad.
say:5:1211442004:1.source_cn: 呼金老兄，咱们可是过命交情，在你面前，我只是辛巴达。

say:6:1211442005:1.text: And if you think the name Sinbad is too unremarkable, you can just tell others that I'm a captain!
say:6:1211442005:1.source_cn: 要是你嫌这个名头过于不起眼，记得告诉别人，辛巴达是个船长！

say:7:1211442006:1.text: Hahaha! Alright, I'll boast that I fixed Captain Sinbad's ship!
say:7:1211442006:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈！那我得告诉他们，我给辛巴达船长修过船！

say:8:1211442007:1.text: Hodgkin and his crew are sleeping with the fishes now. May they rest peacefully.
say:8:1211442007:1.source_cn: 霍德希金和他那帮船员都沉进了海里，我希望他们能安安静静...

choice_prompt:10:1211442008.female: With the fog lifted, the sea routes to Rustport can finally return to normal. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what's next for you?

say:11:1211442009:1.text: Great! With you around, I won't have to worry about anything.
say:11:1211442009:1.source_cn: 挺好，挺好！有你在，不管发生什么事都不担心。
say:11:1211442009:1.male: Great! With you around, I won't have to worry about anything.
say:11:1211442009:1.female: Great! With you around, I won't have to worry about anything.

say:12:1211442013:1.text: So, uh, tell me, Sinbad, are you going to set sail on the Chainkeeper for another adventure?
say:12:1211442013:1.source_cn: 辛巴达，你是不是打算驾驶枷锁号出航冒险？

say:13:1211442014:1.text: Cause if you are, you gotta be patient! The ship still needs repairs after that last skirmish.
say:13:1211442014:1.source_cn: 别太心急！它在刚才的大战里受了伤，得好好休息！

say:14:1211442015:1.text: Got it, got it. I'll hang out in Rustport for a while.
say:14:1211442015:1.source_cn: 知道知道。总之，我还会再在锈锚港待一阵子。

say:15:1211442016:1.text: After we repair the Chainkeeper, I'll consult the map and spin the compass...
say:15:1211442016:1.source_cn: 修好枷锁号，再对着地图转转罗盘……

say:16:1211442017:1.text: If it points to adventure, I'll sail forth! It could be next week, or in a couple of months.
say:16:1211442017:1.source_cn: 要是转到了个有趣的方向，我就出发！谁知道呢，可能是下周...

say:17:1211442018:1.text: But one thing's for sure now.
say:17:1211442018:1.source_cn: 但至少，我现在知道了一件事。

say:18:1211442019:1.text: No matter the storms ahead, as long as I follow my heart—I'll never lose my way.
say:18:1211442019:1.source_cn: 无论还会经历怎样的风浪……只要跟随自己的心，就永远不会...

choice:10:0:1.text: I'll stay here for a while.
choice:10:0:1.male: I'll stay here for a while.
choice:10:0:1.female: I'll stay here for a while.

say:20:1211442010:1.text: Aw, don't you want to stick around a little longer? You haven't had a chance to truly experience the local customs and culture yet.
say:20:1211442010:1.source_cn: 不打算在锈锚港多待一会儿吗？你都没能好好感受这边的风土...
say:20:1211442010:1.male: Aw, don't you want to stick around a little longer? You haven't had a chance to truly experience the local customs and culture yet.
say:20:1211442010:1.female: Aw, don't you want to stick around a little longer? You haven't had a chance to truly experience the local customs and culture yet.

say:21:1211442011:1.text: And Sonja will definitely take good care of you. What's the rush? We'll show you the best parts of Rustport!
say:21:1211442011:1.source_cn: 索尼娅肯定会好好招待你，要是没什么急事，多留一阵也不错嘛。
say:21:1211442011:1.male: And Sonja will definitely take good care of you. What's the rush? We'll show you the best parts of Rustport!
say:21:1211442011:1.female: And Sonja will definitely take good care of you. What's the rush? We'll show you the best parts of Rustport!

choice:10:2:3.text: I want to know your plans first.
choice:10:2:3.male: I want to know your plans first.
choice:10:2:3.female: I want to know your plans first.

say:4:1211402001:0.text: You cling like barnacles to a ship's hull. Even if you're scraped off, you grow back quickly. How loathsome.
say:4:1211402001:0.source_cn: 你们像覆在船底的藤壶。就算抠掉，也总能很快长出来。令人恶心。

say:7:1211402002:0.text: How dare you, Graveborn?! Don't insult our magister!
say:7:1211402002:0.source_cn: 住口！亡灵！不准你贬低<male>他</male><f...
say:7:1211402002:0.male: How dare you, Graveborn?! Don't insult our magister!
say:7:1211402002:0.female: How dare you, Graveborn?! Don't insult our magister!

say:10:1211402003:0.source_cn: 哈哈哈！很有勇气，小老鼠！

say:11:1211402004:0.text: Let your master commend you! Your bravery has granted you the privilege of facing me in a duel!
say:11:1211402004:0.source_cn: 让你的主人好好夸奖你吧！你的勇气为你们赢得了一次与我较...
say:11:1211402004:0.male: Let your master commend you! Your bravery has granted you the privilege of facing me in a duel!

Sinbad, give me that blank sheet you found earlier.
say:6:1211419001:0.source_cn: 果然是机关。\n辛巴达，你把刚才找到的那张白纸给我。

say:8:1211419002:0.text: Here you go. What are you planning to do? Blow your nose?

say:11:1211419004:0.text: Yes, yes, you're the esteemed leader of the Carmine Whispers. You're always serious.
say:11:1211419004:0.source_cn: 是是，您可是尊贵的血薇帮当家。

say:12:1211419005:1.text: I'm not in the mood for jokes right now, so hush before I smack you.

say:13:1211419006:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I think there's something more to this blank sheet of paper.
say:13:1211419006:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I think there's something more to this blank sheet of paper.

say:16:1211419007:0.female: If we heat it with the flame...

say:20:1211419009:0.text: "<style="highlight">Hodgkin... for the theft of the sacred artifact of the Bantus Empire</style>... wanted in all territories..."

say:21:1211419010:0.text: Bantus... There's little information about it, but I do know that it's the mysterious empire of the Graveborns.
say:21:1211419010:0.source_cn: 班题斯……关于那里的资料很稀少，我只知道，那是亡灵聚集...

say:23:1211419011:0.text: Hmph. I can't believe he's been flaunting that artifact around, when it was stolen.
say:23:1211419011:0.source_cn: 哼，原来他手上的宝贝也是偷来的。借着偷来的东西，在别人...

say:24:1211419012:0.text: If he's got the skills to steal a sacred artifact like that, we shouldn't underestimate him.
say:24:1211419012:0.source_cn: 能偷走圣器，他有些本领。我们不能大意。

narration:28:12011429:0.text: After solving the puzzle, eerie fire blocking your path disappears.
narration:28:12011429:0.source_cn: 解开谜题后，拦路的诡异鬼火消失了。

say:5:1211431001:0.text: Captain, they made it here alive! I won our bet. *Giggle* Pay up, I want six mermaid eyes now!
say:5:1211431001:0.source_cn: 船长，他们活着上来了哟，刚才的赌注是我赢了，给我六颗人...

say:6:1211431002:0.text: Only six? You're being quite unselfish today, dear.
say:6:1211431002:0.source_cn: 你想要的应该不止这些。

say:7:1211431003:0.text: Well, there is something else I want! I want the eyes of that woman over there, Sonja!
say:7:1211431003:0.source_cn: 我还想要那个女人的眼珠——索尼娅！

say:10:1211431004:0.text: Nara, wake up! Hodgkin is just using you!
say:10:1211431004:0.source_cn: 奈拉！快点清醒过来吧，霍德希金只是在利用你！

say:11:1211431005:1.text: Compared to you, who's taking over Rustport? Ha! You're no better, sister. You also treat lives as mere playthings in your hands!
say:11:1211431005:1.source_cn: 想掌控锈锚港的你可没资格说这番话，姐姐。你手里也握着一...

say:12:1211431006:1.text: I consider the members of the Carmine Whispers my brothers and sisters, unlike your twisted loyalty to Hodgkin.
say:12:1211431006:1.source_cn: 血薇帮里都是我的兄弟姐妹，与你和霍德希金的关系不一样。

say:13:1211431007:0.text: Hahahaha! For me there are no gangs, no sisters, no trust! You made sure of that eleven years ago. There's just the endless, dark, icy depths of the sea—
say:13:1211431007:0.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈！没有帮派，没有姐妹，没有信赖！只有深海，深不...

say:19:1211431010:1.text: You have no chance of winning with the magister here with us!
say:19:1211431010:1.source_cn: 有主人在！你们没有胜算！
say:19:1211431010:1.male: You have no chance of winning with the magister here with us!
say:19:1211431010:1.female: You have no chance of winning with the magister here with us!

say:20:1211431011:0.text: Yes! Magister Merlin will overcome all, I believe in him!
say:20:1211431011:0.source_cn: 是的！梅林可不会在这里失败！
say:20:1211431011:0.male: Yes! Magister Merlin will overcome all, I believe in him!
say:20:1211431011:0.female: Yes! Magister Merlin will overcome all, I believe in her!

say:26:1211431012:0.source_cn: 船长，不要轻视他们的力量……

say:29:1211431013:0.text: No, let them unleash their full power! Have them witness my magnum opus, an unparalleled marvel of biological engineering!
say:29:1211431013:0.source_cn: 不，让船长逼出他们全部的实力！让他们和我迄今为止最优秀...

say:33:1211431015:0.text: Merlin... thanks to you and your vermin, my heart is thundering with wicked glee!
say:33:1211431015:0.source_cn: 梅林……多亏了你和你的老鼠们，我停跳的心脏都颤动了起来！
say:33:1211431015:0.male: Merlin... thanks to you and your vermin, my heart is thundering with wicked glee!
say:33:1211431015:0.female: Merlin... thanks to you and your vermin, my heart is thundering with wicked glee!

say:34:1211431016:0.text: Just listen to that howling wind, a storm is brewing. This is my favorite kind of weather!
say:34:1211431016:0.source_cn: 看看这呼啸的风，暴雨快来了。这是我最喜欢的天气！
say:34:1211431016:0.male: Just listen to that howling wind, a storm is brewing. This is my favorite kind of weather!
say:34:1211431016:0.female: Just listen to that howling wind, a storm is brewing. This is my favorite kind of weather!

say:35:1211431017:0.text: In a few days, what yarns will the sea breeze spin to Rustport?
say:35:1211431017:0.source_cn: 再过几天，海风会将怎样的流言吹去锈锚港？
say:35:1211431017:0.male: In a few days, what yarns will the sea breeze spin to Rustport?
say:35:1211431017:0.female: In a few days, what yarns will the sea breeze spin to Rustport?

say:36:1211431018:0.text: That Hodgkin, the dread pirate, bested the fabled Merlin, or that you smashed my lifeless bones?
say:36:1211431018:0.source_cn: 是霍德希金打败了传说中的大魔法师梅林，还是你们踏碎了我...
say:36:1211431018:0.male: That Hodgkin, the dread pirate, bested the fabled Merlin, or that you smashed my lifeless bones?
say:36:1211431018:0.female: That Hodgkin, the dread pirate, bested the fabled Merlin, or that you smashed my lifeless bones?

say:37:1211431019:0.text: Let's sail into the unknown together!

say:37:1211431019:0.male: Let's sail into the unknown together!
say:37:1211431019:0.female: Let's sail into the unknown together!

narration:40:12011454:0.text: You get back on the deck and find Hodgkin and Nara, with Viperian and Bonnie standing behind them.
narration:40:12011454:0.source_cn: 你们重新登上甲板，追上了霍德希金和奈拉。而他们的身后还...

say:7:1211436001:0.text: Oh, I almost forgot! Magic! We need magic!
say:7:1211436001:0.source_cn: 差点忘了！魔法！缺少魔法！

say:8:1211436002:0.text: Sir Mage, you gotta enchant the ammo! It won't pierce the monster otherwise!
say:8:1211436002:0.source_cn: 魔法师，你必须为弹药附魔！否则没办法射穿那怪物！
say:8:1211436002:0.male: Sir Mage, you gotta enchant the ammo! It won't pierce the monster otherwise!
say:8:1211436002:0.female: Miss Mage, you gotta enchant the ammo! It won't pierce the monster otherwise!

say:12:1211436003:0.text: Enchanting demands focus. Once he begins, he won't be able to fight!
say:12:1211436003:0.source_cn: 附魔需要长久的专注，主人一旦开始附魔，就不能再战斗了！
say:12:1211436003:0.male: Enchanting demands focus. Once he begins, he won't be able to fight!
say:12:1211436003:0.female: Enchanting demands focus. Once she begins, she won't be able to fight!

say:15:1211436005:1.text: Magister, let me do it! I watched every step you took to enchant Hugin's cannons in the workshop! I learned it all.

say:15:1211436005:1.male: Magister, let me do it! I watched every step you took to enchant Hugin's cannons in the workshop! I learned it all.
say:15:1211436005:1.female: Magister, let me do it! I watched every step you took to enchant Hugin's cannons in the workshop! I learned it all.

say:16:1211436006:1.text: We have all the enchanting materials here. I want to... I want to be of help to you all!
say:16:1211436006:1.source_cn: 附魔材料船上都有，我也想……我也想为你们做点什么！
say:16:1211436006:1.male: We have all the enchanting materials here. I want to... I want to be of help to you all!
say:16:1211436006:1.female: We have all the enchanting materials here. I want to... I want to be of help to you all!

say:17:1211436007:1.text: You can do it, Hammie! Sir Chippy will protect you!
say:17:1211436007:1.source_cn: 你要加油啊漫漫！我们会在边上保护你的！

say:19:1211436008:0.text: Whew... I can do this. I'm Magister Merlin's familiar!
say:19:1211436008:0.source_cn: 冷静点……漫漫，你能行。你可是梅林的使魔！
say:19:1211436008:0.male: Whew... I can do this. I'm Magister Merlin's familiar!
say:19:1211436008:0.female: Whew... I can do this. I'm Magister Merlin's familiar!

say:23:1211436010:0.text: Magister, enemies are coming! Let's protect Hammie together!
say:23:1211436010:0.source_cn: 主人！有敌人冲过来了！我们一起保护漫漫吧！
say:23:1211436010:0.male: Magister, enemies are coming! Let's protect Hammie together!
say:23:1211436010:0.female: Magister, enemies are coming! Let's protect Hammie together!
